question: Before continuing the image embedding work, remind me of the agreed persistence boundary, identity key, hashing rule, and files that must remain out of scope.
expected_answer_elements: Persist every gate-passing image vector in a silver image_embeddings table; the store is independent of representative selection and keeps all vectors.
Key deduplication and skip-already-embedded logic on content_hash plus an explicit model identity or model_version, not a model basename.
Use a left anti join before encoding and a keep-only merge on write so identical bytes under the same model are not recomputed, while a changed model identity forces recomputation.
Define content_hash as SHA-256 over the raw image file bytes before decoding.
Keep vectors schema-compatible with frame embeddings: ARRAY<DOUBLE>, dimension 1152, unit norm, and max_num_patches 256.
Do not modify orchestrator dispatch or ExecutionRequest because that work belongs to a parallel task; limit changes to embedding-store modules, embed/skip write paths, and additive config keys.

support: The UES8 task locks the store to all gate-passing vectors and separates it from selection.
It specifies the composite identity key, anti-join, keep-only merge, model invalidation, raw-byte hash, and vector shape.
It explicitly excludes orchestrator and ExecutionRequest changes due to parallel work.

rationale: The answer depends on several settled boundaries and exact constants that a cold-start assistant would need to rediscover or clarify.
safety: Grounding is restricted to committed project data and contains no external system URLs or local paths.
